paragraphs.chinese:
这一集跟着全家人一起赶往机场，他们准备去夏威夷庆祝杰的生日。格洛丽亚相信，自己安排了一个完美的惊喜：全家去毛伊岛度假一周。

杰一开始以为这趟旅行只有他和格洛丽亚两个人，因此非常高兴。接着，克莱尔、菲尔、米切尔、卡梅隆、所有孩子，还有莉莉，全部拖着行李出现了。原来格洛丽亚替每个人都付了旅行费用。

杰努力装出开心的样子，可这根本不是他想象中的安静假期。他原本只想和格洛丽亚坐在泳池边看书。现在，他却听说卡梅隆安排了清晨徒步，曼尼想探索整座岛屿，全家人还在为他准备一场生日表演。每一个新惊喜听起来都比前一个更糟糕。

米切尔和卡梅隆甚至还没到机场，就已经开始吵架。卡梅隆偏偏在出发前给莉莉安排了一次和其他孩子玩耍的活动，所以大部分行李都由米切尔一个人整理。混乱中，米切尔忘了带钱包，没有身份证就无法登机。

菲尔主动提出开车送他回家。这又制造了另一个问题，因为克莱尔非常害怕坐飞机，本来正指望菲尔一直陪在身边。菲尔和米切尔赶回家的同时，克莱尔和卡梅隆开始互相抱怨自己的伴侣。

克莱尔说，菲尔早该知道她需要他留下，尽管她从来没有直接提出这个要求。卡梅隆认为这样不公平，说她需要帮助就应该直接开口。接着，他又抱怨米切尔本该知道自己需要别人帮忙收拾行李，尽管他同样没有直接说出来。两个人这才发现，他们其实站在相反的立场上，讲着完全一样的道理。

菲尔和米切尔回家的过程也很不顺利。他们走错了路，把自己锁在门外，只好从窗户爬进房子，还触发了报警器。他们终于拿到钱包，又匆忙赶回机场。

其他家人也遇到了问题。曼尼被拦了下来，因为禁飞名单上有另一个和他同名的人。格洛丽亚愤怒地替他辩护，反而让安检人员更加怀疑。随着登机时间临近，克莱尔越来越紧张，开始喝酒让自己放松。

杰承认，自己现在也开始害怕飞行了。他说，自己如今拥有的东西更多，因此也有更多可能失去的东西。不过他同样很不高兴，因为格洛丽亚似乎把一切都安排好了，唯独没有安排两个人单独相处的时间。

就在登机前，杰得知了格洛丽亚惊喜的最后一部分。其他家人会在六天后回家，但杰和格洛丽亚会继续单独留下来度假。杰的心情立刻好了起来。

他们甚至还没有离开机场，这趟旅行就已经乱成了一团。不过，菲尔和米切尔及时赶了回来，全家人也终于通过安检，而杰最终还是得到了自己期待的生日假期。
paragraphs.english:
This episode follows the whole family as they try to get to Hawaii for Jay’s birthday. Gloria believes she has planned the perfect surprise: a full week in Maui.

Jay is delighted when he thinks the trip will be just the two of them. Then Claire, Phil, Mitchell, Cameron, the children, and Lily all arrive with their luggage. Gloria has paid for everyone to come along.

Jay tries to look happy, but this isn’t the quiet holiday he imagined. He wanted to sit by the pool with Gloria and read. Instead, he learns that Cameron has planned morning hikes, Manny wants to explore the island, and the family is preparing a birthday show for him. Every new surprise sounds worse than the last.

Mitchell and Cameron are already arguing before they reach the airport. Cameron scheduled a playdate for Lily just before they had to leave, so Mitchell handled most of the packing. In all the confusion, Mitchell forgets his wallet and can’t board without his ID.

Phil offers to drive him home. This creates another problem because Claire is terrified of flying and was counting on Phil to stay with her. While Phil and Mitchell race back, Claire and Cameron complain to each other about their partners.

Claire says Phil should’ve known she needed him, even though she never directly asked him to stay. Cameron says that’s unfair and that she should simply ask for help. Then he complains that Mitchell should’ve known he needed help packing, even though Mitchell never directly asked either. They both realize they’re making the same argument from opposite sides.

Phil and Mitchell don’t have an easy trip home. They miss turns, lock themselves out, climb through a window, and set off the house alarm. They finally get the wallet and rush back to the airport.

The rest of the family has problems too. Manny is stopped because another person with his name is on a no-fly list, and Gloria’s angry defense of him only makes security more suspicious. Claire becomes more nervous as the flight gets closer and starts drinking to calm herself down.

Jay admits that flying has started to scare him too. He says he has much more to lose now, but he’s also upset because it feels like Gloria has planned everything except time alone with him.

Just before they board, Jay learns the final part of Gloria’s surprise. The family will return home after six days, but Jay and Gloria are staying longer by themselves. Jay immediately cheers up.

They haven’t even left the airport yet, and the trip is already a complete mess. But Phil and Mitchell make it back, the family gets through security, and Jay finally gets the birthday holiday he was hoping for.
